recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密集，紅血球系與顆粒球系前驅細胞皆增加（三系增生 panmyelosis），並見數顆大型、核分葉過多且多形的巨核細胞（hyperlobated megakaryocytes），缺乏明顯雲朵狀深染核或纖維化，符合真性紅血球增多症的增生期。
features: Several large megakaryocytes with hyperlobated, loosely folded nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, focally clustered
Megakaryocytes vary in size (pleomorphic) without markedly hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei
Increased erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei alongside granulocytic precursors (panmyelosis)
No overt fibrosis or sinusoidal streaming in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage proliferation, including increased erythroid precursors and granulocytic elements. Megakaryocytes are increased and pleomorphic, ranging to large forms with hyperlobated nuclei, and are focally loosely clustered. Megakaryocytes with dense hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and stromal fibrosis are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm showing panmyelosis, compatible with polycythemia vera in the proliferative (polycythemic) phase.

ddx.vs: Proliferation is mainly of large to giant staghorn megakaryocytes with normal cellularity and no significant erythroid or granulocytic expansion.
Megakaryocytes form dense clusters with hyperchromatic, bulbous cloud-like nuclei and abnormal N:C ratio, with granulocytic rather than erythroid predominance.
Shows erythroid hyperplasia only, without megakaryocytic pleomorphism or panmyelosis, and lacks JAK2 mutation with normal or high EPO.
